data.narrative:
Aeon Industrial is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Naweed Tahmas and Joe Cieslik that has raised $18.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies spanning the defense technology sector: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsink, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression uses the $18.6M raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $46.5M. Peer-Median analysis examines 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—producing a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M–$1.0B.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $40M–$460M, with a median of $223M. This wide spread reflects material uncertainty in comparable selection: UFORCE's $1.0B valuation as a Seed peer substantially elevates the peer median, while Stage-Progression mechanically extends only the capitalized raise. The low end ($40M) assumes conservation relative to raised capital; the high end reflects peer multiples. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, defensibility of technology differentiation relative to named competitors, and whether UFORCE represents a true comparator or an outlier. Additional data on Aeon's revenue, customer concentration, and near-term funding plans would narrow this range considerably.
